g.text: Methodology: §3.2 — What we measured; §7.9 — De-duplication rule 3

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: The code service has a median input of 1,469 tokens but a median output of 13 tokens - the signature of inline completion rather than

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: chat. Conversation medians are 1,020 input and 129 output. This asymmetry, not a difference in volume, is what drives the gap in

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: output share between the two services. Caveat: the 2023 release covers a single 58-minute window on 16 November 2023, so it is a

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: snapshot rather than a representative period, and it predates reasoning models and agentic tool-calling, both of which lengthen

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: output. Bins are left-closed powers of two; the two services are separate workloads and their distributions must not be pooled.
